data.final_week_advice: With only one week remaining, prioritize high-yield units like Equilibrium, Acids and Bases, and Thermochemistry for the final exam. Focus on timed practice and reviewing key concepts rather than learning new material.
data.summary: This one-week plan focuses on a comprehensive review of all AP Chemistry units, with an emphasis on high-yield topics like Equilibrium, Acids and Bases, and Thermochemistry. The schedule includes timed practice and targeted review to maximize exam readiness.

tasks: Review key concepts from Units 1-9, focusing on Equilibrium, Acids and Bases, and Thermochemistry
Do 10 free-response questions on Equilibrium and Acids and Bases, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a timed practice exam covering all units
Review mistakes from the practice exam and revisit relevant topics
